feeds.title: American Atheists
feeds.description: American Atheists advocates for the absolute separation of religion from government and for the acceptance of atheism in the public sphere. American Atheists fights to protect the absolute separation of religion from government and works to elevate atheists and atheism in the public discourse.

feeds.title: History for Atheists
feeds.description: New atheists getting history wrong. he misuse of history and the use of biased, erroneous or distorted pseudo history by anti-theistic atheists. The author is an atheist himself so no, this is not some theist apologetics blog. It is simply an attempt to call out and correct the misuse of history, because rationalists should not base their arguments on errors and distortions.

feeds.title: Atheist Revolution
feeds.description: This is a blog for people who are tired of irrational belief and religious extremism. Here you will find post on atheism, secularism, reason, skepticism, and freethought.

feeds.title: Atheist Ireland
feeds.description: Atheist Ireland is a real-life Irish advocacy group that promotes atheism, reason and ethical secularism. Our mission is for people who wish to work together to build a rational, ethical and secular society free from superstition and supernaturalism.

feeds.title: Debunking Christianity
feeds.description: The blog of atheist author John Loftus, a former Christian apologist.

feeds.title: Vridar
feeds.description: Musings on biblical studies, politics, religion, ethics, human nature, tidbits from naturalist's perspective.

feeds.title: Randal Rauser Blog
feeds.description: Randal Rauser is a systematic and analytic theologian of evangelical persuasion. He is driven by apologetic concerns and above all by the tireless pursuit of truth. Randal does not despair of finding truth, for he believes that in a profound sense Jesus Christ is the truth.

feeds.title: Damien Marie AtHope Blog
feeds.description: I am an Axiological Atheist, Antitheist, Antireligionist, Ignostic, Secularist, Humanist, Rationalist, Writer, Artist, Poet, Philosopher, educated in Psychology and Sociology. AtHope is an Axiological Atheist, or constructive, atheism rejects the existence of gods in favor of a 'higher absolute', such as humanity and the science of value in formal axiology. Blog by Damien Marie AtHope.

feeds.title: Blind Faith: Blind Folly
feeds.description: A collection of sometimes serious, sometimes entertaining, often wry reflections, teasers, and ticklers, to help believers on the brink realize that their belief has blinded them to the vision and the truth that alone can make them free.

feeds.title: Religious Atheism Blog
feeds.description: Discovering religion traced history and the development of philosophy and required a better understanding of science. The direction now is further discovery of the history of the philosophy of science. Recent archaeology and research have uncovered interesting insights.

feeds.title: Atheist Freethinkers
feeds.description: Deep thoughts and reflections on Philosophical Materialism, Critical Thought, Secularism, and Atheism. Dive into a stream of Free-thinking ideas and discussions drawing upon recent events concerning Freedom of Speech, Rationalism, and more. Atheist Freethinkers is a Atheist association, domiciled in Montreal, Quebec, Canada

feeds.title: Atheists United
feeds.description: Stay updated with News and Announcements from Atheists United, California's Atheist Hub. Through our blog and other resources, we strive to build thriving atheist communities, empower people to express their secular values, and promote the separation of government and religion.

feeds.title: Herb Silverman Blog
feeds.description: Herb Silverman is a mild-mannered mathematics professor and liberal, Jewish, Yankee atheist who ran for Governor of South Carolina to change the Constitution, which prohibited atheists from holding public office. A most original and humorous voice.

feeds.title: Friendly Atheist
feeds.description: I'm Hemant Mehta (pronounced HEH-mint MEH-tuh). I've been writing about atheism, religion, politics since around 2006. My work has been cited in books and media outlets, and it takes up 98% of my waking life.

feeds.title: Skeptical Faith
feeds.description: A discussion of faith, belief and religion for people who have given up on God and/or religion. The blog, published every Thursday, is meant to show that faith and skepticism are not mutually exclusive.

feeds.title: Freethought Blogs
feeds.description: ​Freethought Blogs is a network of independent blogs offering commentary on atheism, science, politics, social justice, and secular humanism, featuring diverse voices like PZ Myers and Adam Lee.

feeds.title: Strange Notions
feeds.description: Strange Notion is the central place of dialogue between Catholics and atheists. The digital home for Catholic and atheist dialogue.

feeds.title: Unreasonable Faith
feeds.description: I'm Joseph. I was an evangelical Christian for over a decade, completely convinced that God was real and Jesus was alive today. I was wrong. I no longer believe in a personal God or that Jesus was born of a virgin, worked miracles, and rose from the dead. I don't believe in heaven or hell, angels or demons, holy books or prophecy. I don't believe the earth was created 6,000 years ago, or that God intelligently designed every species. I now consider myself an atheist and a skeptic. Follow my reasonable blog on atheism, religion, science, and skepticism.

feeds.title: Wastelands of Unbelief Blog
feeds.description: This blog is the creation of Jeff Stueber and named after his recent book The Vast Wastelands of Unbelief published by Tate Publishing. It covers the same type of material as the book: a critique of secular arguments whether from atheists, humanists, evolutionists or liberals.

feeds.title: Atheist Girl » Atheism
feeds.description: I am the treehugging, animalprotecting, freethinking, humanist, liberal, heathen your parents warned you about.. I am atheist. I don't think there is no God; I know there's no God. I believe that Atheism is, in a broad sense, the rejection of belief in the existence of deities. In a narrower sense, atheism is specifically the position that there are no deities.

feeds.title: Atheistwatch Blog
feeds.description: To Understand the atheist truth regime in terms of its ideology and keep tabs on its propaganda and tactics.

feeds.title: Atheist Ethicist Blog
feeds.description: A view of right and wrong, good and evil, in a universe without gods. Alonzo Fyfe might be the clearest, most careful thinker in the atheist blogosphere today. He's a great writer, and may have made a huge contribution to ethical philosophy with desire utilitarianism.

feeds.title: Atheist Alliance International Blog
feeds.description: Atheist Alliance International (AAI) is a global federation of atheist groups and individuals committed to educating its members and the public about atheism, secularism, and related issues.

feeds.title: Rosa Rubicondior
feeds.description: Rosa Rubicondior talks about Religion, Creationism, evolution, science, and politics from a center-left atheist humanist perspective in her blog. She shares new findings and research and cleverly dissects them to develop a set of rational arguments for science and atheism against creationism. Read her latest thoughts in new updates.

feeds.title: Secular Underground Network
feeds.description: Covers articles for atheists related to moral support, job finding, fleeing a dangerous situation, giving shelter, study, help. The purpose is to connect atheists, agnosts, secularists, apostates and their friends to support our members in need.

feeds.title: Canadian Atheist
feeds.description: Canadian Atheist is an independent blog made up of a collection of atheist/secular/freethought writers from across Canada. Many Canadian Atheist writers are members of one or more atheist, secular and freethough organizations.
